one_liner: Reducto offers a REST document parsing/extraction API with free self-serve signup ($150 credits), bearer API keys, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API key created in Studio. Workload Identity (OIDC federated short-lived tokens) is also offered as an alternative.
access_notes: Free Studio account with $150 free credits, no credit card required; API keys created self-serve.
blocker_notes: None; free credits allow building and testing.

evidence.quote: In the Studio sidebar, click **API Keys**, then **Create API Key**. Give it a name and copy the key.
Standard accounts include $150 in free credits.
Parse API - Extract API - Edit API - Split API
The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit documents from any MCP-compatible agent
